outcome.technical: plugins/audit/hooks/_config.py: (1) the invariant is stated once, in a comment block above the new _argument_runs: a heredoc whose substitution is the whole or part of one double-quoted argument is data whatever command carries the argument, unless that command runs what it is handed. _holds_output_as_text (a list of two vouched consumers) is replaced by _argument_runs/_word_runs_argument, which name the ways a command runs an argument instead: command position, an assignment-shaped partial, a wrapper prefix leaving no program (program_candidates), a shell anywhere in the words ('.' only in program position), an interpreter anywhere that is not a plain script run of its first two words (or any interpreter when an interpreter env option is assigned in the command), a program in the new _RUNS_AN_OPERAND (eval, trap, find, ssh, su, chroot, watch, ...), and git other than a commit/tag message value. The argument may now be part of the quoted string (the old opener-adjacent check is dropped); unquoted or nested substitutions still stay shell. (2) _scan_contexts tracks a backquote as a substitution context, inside double quotes too, and _substitution_runs_body reads the innermost of either opener. (3) _STDIN_SHELL and _STDIN_INTERP anchor their program names to the start of a word (new _PROGRAM_WORD), so a file name ending in a shell name (notes.sh, report.sh, env.zsh) is not a shell; shells by name, by path, after a reserved word, dot-sourced and at a pipe's far side still are. split_heredocs' docstring updated. tests/test__config.py: new group _argument_body_cases, hb6-hb11 (allow/deny per route); the stale comment near tr8c rewritten. tests/test_guard_history_rewrite.py: gh35 re-pointed from 'known limit: cat > probe.sh is refused' to 'cat > probe.sh is allowed AND sh probe.sh <<EOF is refused'.
